name: Indurium Ore
summary: Pozzik plans to work indurium into several parts of the racers, which calls for a great deal of raw ore. The ore is to be had at the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. The gnomes are already getting hold of their own, and Pozzik wants to keep up with them.

sections.title: Ore from Uldaman
sections.body: Pozzik asks for four pieces of raw indurium ore. It can be had at the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. The gnomes are already getting hold of their own, so Pozzik wants a supply too. This follows Rizzle's Schematics.

faq.q: Why does Pozzik want indurium ore?
faq.answer: He wants to work indurium into several parts of the racers, and that takes a great deal of raw ore.

faq.q: Where is the indurium ore found?
aliases: where do i get indurium ore
faq.answer: At the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why does it matter to get the ore?
faq.answer: The gnomes are already getting hold of their own indurium, and Pozzik wants to keep up with them.
It follows Rizzle's Schematics, which itself follows Keeping Pace.
